verdict.rationale: Forter documents several official first-party SDKs: the Forter3DS SDK for iOS (Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods) and Android (Maven), a hosted-fields SDK, and mobile SDKs that send location updates. These cover client-side and 3DS scenarios, but the evidence shows no SDK for the core order-decision and order-status APIs. missing for 10: server-side language SDKs for the core fraud decision/order APIs, SDK reference depth (versioning, language coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Forter3DS SDK offers flexible integration options, supporting both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods.
Forter3DS SDK supports installation via Maven
Our hosted fields are rendered in secure iframes, ensuring that card numbers, CVV codes, and other sensitive payment data are handled securely.
